detectedFeatures.name: NetBIOS
detectedFeatures.benefit: Device is discoverable on campus network
detectedFeatures.guide: NetBIOS network discovery allows student devices on the same subnet to resolve hostnames automatically.

detectedFeatures.name: SMB File Sharing
detectedFeatures.benefit: Share datasets and models across campus
detectedFeatures.guide: Windows SMB file sharing allows fast 500+ Mbps file transfers over Wi-Fi without using mobile internet data.

missingFeatures.name: SSH Server
missingFeatures.benefit: Remote terminal access for automation
missingFeatures.guide: OpenSSH Server enables secure encrypted terminal access for remote cluster orchestration and automated model deployment.

missingFeatures.name: Node.js Server
missingFeatures.benefit: Become a backup server node for 24/7 campus uptime
missingFeatures.guide: Node.js powers the campus supercomputer portal server and WebSocket relay. Installing Node.js lets your device act as a redundant backup portal server if the main host goes offline.

missingFeatures.name: Python API (Flask)
missingFeatures.benefit: Serve custom ML models via API
missingFeatures.guide: Flask is a lightweight Python web framework. It lets you write custom microservices and REST endpoints to serve AI predictions across the campus network.

missingFeatures.name: Gradio
missingFeatures.benefit: Create AI web demos in 5 lines of Python
missingFeatures.guide: Gradio lets you quickly create user interfaces for machine learning models and Python functions. Classmates on the campus Wi-Fi can open your Gradio web app port (7860) directly in their browsers.

missingFeatures.name: Python API (FastAPI)
missingFeatures.benefit: Async Python API for real-time AI
missingFeatures.guide: FastAPI is an async, high-performance Python framework. Perfect for building ultra-fast AI inference APIs with automatic Swagger documentation.

missingFeatures.name: Streamlit
missingFeatures.benefit: Build interactive ML dashboards
missingFeatures.guide: Streamlit turns Python data scripts into interactive dashboards. Running Streamlit on port 8501 shares interactive AI visualizations across the intranet.

missingFeatures.name: Jupyter Notebook
missingFeatures.benefit: Share GPU-powered notebooks with classmates
missingFeatures.guide: Jupyter Notebook gives you an interactive browser environment for Python, PyTorch, and Data Science. Running Jupyter allows you to share live code notebooks with classmates over the intranet.

missingFeatures.name: Ollama (Local LLM)
missingFeatures.description: Run AI models locally on GPU or CPU/RAM
missingFeatures.benefit: Run 100% private neural network models offline on your laptop!
missingFeatures.guide: Ollama allows your laptop to run open-weight AI models (Google Gemma 2, Llama 3.2, DeepSeek-R1) offline locally on CPU/RAM or GPU. Once installed, running `ollama run gemma2:2b` streams responses to the campus AI studio.

recommendedModels.name: Google Gemma 2 (2B)
recommendedModels.note: Fast & Lightweight for Intel/AMD CPU or GPU

recommendedModels.name: Qwen 2.5 Coder (1.5B)
recommendedModels.note: Ultra-Fast Python, C++, Java & Web Code
